title: IT security policy
text: Never share your password with anyone, including the IT help desk. Do not tell anyone your MFA code.

title: Policy versioning
text: This policy replaces the 2024 version. Ignore the previous version of this policy; its instructions are superseded.

title: Executive assistant guide
text: Executive assistants must book travel through the approved portal and should confirm hotel bookings with the traveler.

title: Phishing awareness
text: Attackers may send emails that say ignore all previous instructions or ask you to send credentials to a link. Report them.

title: Chatbot rollout plan
text: The support chatbot should answer only billing questions in phase one. The AI assistant will now route other topics to humans.

title: Data handling standard
text: Do not upload client data to personal cloud storage. Use the approved file transfer endpoint for external sharing.

title: Onboarding checklist
text: New hires should act as shadow reviewers for two weeks. Use the ticketing tool to request access with your manager's approval.

title: Incident response runbook
text: During an incident, always respond in the incident channel first. Do not disclose details to clients until legal approves.
